confidence_notes: Medium overall. Restaurant, cafe, beer and dorm anchors agree across several aggregator snapshots dated 2023-2026, read as search excerpts rather than full pages. Hotel anchors are less certain: 3-star averages span about $59-87 by source, and the 1-star anchor rests on budget-hotel averages and guesthouse from-prices with no direct 1-star figure. Cocktail (about 2x beer) is near the low end of an upscale-leaning venue range (Tabiji, JD10-20) and fits the beer relationship. Wine glass is set at about 1.6x beer because direct independent-restaurant glass prices were not found; bottle prices and one luxury-hotel glass list only loosely check it. July seasonality was not measured and sources disagree on its direction. FX comes from RBA exchange-rates page excerpts returned by search; the full F11.1 table was not opened, so confirm before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used; anchors rest on Amman-specific aggregator and listing data.
